performance_case.causal_mechanism: Exact empty pre-provisioned Windows roots let the fixed interpretation and design runners accept a completed manifest-bound R1 handoff without caller-selected paths, repair behavior or an additional clock.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This audit may establish only local fixed-root provisioning readiness and an exact bounded next action. It cannot read outcomes or establish prediction, fees, slippage, capacity, PnL, drawdown improvement, candidate readiness, OOS value, schedule activation or Trading authority.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Immediate drawdown effect is zero. Any market drawdown improvement remains MISSING_PROOF until a later preregistered matched-capital experiment passes Validation and sealed OOS gates.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: Leaving required roots absent can stall the completed R1 Local pipeline and consume operator time; over-engineering or pre-creating receiver-owned roots can weaken create-once boundaries, so the audit must choose the smallest exact safe action.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: Root readiness cannot improve fee-adjusted PnL directly, but removing an avoidable post-R1 fail-closed stop should reduce time from sealed forward evidence to a credible accept-or-reject strategy decision.
